title: Chapter 58 — The Account Review
intro: The quarterly ritual — share, leakage, and the review meeting.

sections.title: The Quarterly Review
sections.content:
Every major account deserves a quarterly review. How much business did they give you? How much did they give someone else? Where is the leakage — and why?

The review meeting is not a confrontation. It is a partnership conversation. 'We did X together this quarter. Where can we do better next quarter?'

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating account reviews, ask:

Are quarterly reviews happening with major accounts — or being skipped?
Does the salesperson know their share of each account's business?
Are they addressing leakage proactively?
